entity.name: Vaibhav Chhajer
entity.description: Mathematics researcher building Scriptavera, an open-source tool that turns handwritten research notes into faithful research papers.

projects.name: Scriptavera
projects.description: Turns handwritten research notes (scans or photos) into a LaTeX research paper in small, checked steps. The author confirms the notation, every doubtful reading and every figure, and a mechanical audit checks that every formula reaches the paper unchanged. Mathematics first; designed for any field.

channels.description: Write to arrange a grant or a donation; bank details are given on request.

plans.name: 12-Month Full Engineering Team, Compute Infrastructure & Indian University Pilot
plans.description: Full 12-month budget ($86,900 USD / Rs 73,00,000 INR) covering the 3-person core engineering team (Principal Investigator, Applied AI & Mathematical Pipeline Engineer, Full-Stack Systems & LaTeX Sandbox Engineer), dedicated GPU server rental and zero-retention frontier API compute for the 1-year free academic pilot across IITs, NITs, IISc, IISERs, ISI, TIFR, and CMI, developer workstations, and workspace infrastructure.
